answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using hardware-attested parallax verification. Verifiers issue a live nonce, requiring nodes to submit sensor-signed frames of a shared dynamic scene, such as waves passing an ivory piling beside a jetty in an inlet. Epipolar checks confirm distinct vantage points, forcing an attacker to deploy separate secure-enclave cameras per identity. However, fog or visual occlusion breaks feature matching, causing false rejections.
